Ava Morales: Quick sync — prepping QBR for Crestline next Wed. Need slide owners, open risks, and enablement asks by EOD tomorrow. TL;DR: exec readout + deep-dive on onboarding gaps.

Jonah Lee: Got it. I can own onboarding health slide. Will pull activation metrics and top 3 drop-off funnels.

Priya Singh: I’ll own exec asks + renewal risk summary. Can we flag any customers with renewal <60% likelihood?

Ava Morales: @Priya yes please. Use the renewal signal rubric from last quarter. Highlight any support tickets tied to model regressions.

Miles Carter: Dropping in enablement ask — request for a 20-min product demo clip to include in deep-dive. @Samir can you record a short walkthrough?

Samir Rao: On it. I’ll record 2 variants (30s + 90s). Upload to the shared drive by EOD.

Nora Patel: FYI finance wants ARR movement on slide 4 — will need committed vs. forecast numbers. @Ava I can pull a one-pager if you confirm the format.

Ava Morales: Confirmed — one-pager format same as last QBR (revenue, churn, expansion signal). Thanks @Nora.

Jonah Lee: Heads up: onboarding funnel shows a spike in LLM execution errors for one customer segment. I’ll add a callout with sample logs.

Priya Singh: Noted. I’ll correlate that with support ticket volume and any renewal comments from CSMs.

Ava Morales: Action items so far:
• Jonah: onboarding health + funnel callouts (slides 6–7)
• Priya: renewal risk + exec asks (slides 2–3)
• Miles/Samir: demo clip (embedded on slide 8)
• Nora: ARR one-pager (slide 4)
Please drop one-line status updates in this thread when complete.

deploy-bot: Reminder — QBR slides template v3 uploaded to /shared/QBR/templates at 1843216800.

Miles Carter: Quick question on tone: do we keep the deep-dive technical or high-level for execs?

Ava Morales: High-level for execs, technical appendix for engineering stakeholders. Keep 1–2 risk slides with recommended mitigations.

Priya Singh: I found two accounts with renewal risk flagged: Crestline (50%) and Harborline (55%). Will draft suggested mitigation asks (discount runway + embedded enablement).

Jonah Lee: Uploaded funnel charts and sample logs to the slide deck. Added a short note about an ETA for the runtime patch.

Samir Rao: Demo clips uploaded: crestline_demo_30s.mp4 and crestline_demo_90s.mp4. Link: https://drive.redwood/crestdemo (share perms set).

Nora Patel: ARR one-pager ready and attached to the deck. Added a small note about credit adjustments for Harborline.

Ava Morales: Great progress. Two quick asks: 1) @Priya, add the customer sentiment quote from last NPS call (one-liner). 2) @Jonah, add the expected latency improvement number after patch.

Priya Singh: Added sentiment quote and a recommended executive ask — offer a dedicated enablement workshop pre-renewal.

Jonah Lee: Latency improvement expected ~18–22% post-patch. Added to the slide footnote.

Ava Morales: Scheduling: exec rehearsal Friday 10:00–10:30 PT. Can everyone confirm availability?

Miles Carter: Confirmed.

Samir Rao: Confirmed.

Priya Singh: Confirmed.

Jonah Lee: Confirmed.

Nora Patel: Confirmed.

Ava Morales: Thanks all. Final deliverable checklist (please reply with DONE when finished):
- Slides updated with owner's content
- Demo clip embedded and linked
- ARR one-pager attached
- Risks + mitigations summarized
- Exec ask lines prepared

Jonah Lee: DONE — slides and notes updated.

Samir Rao: DONE — clips embedded and links validated.

Nora Patel: DONE — ARR page in place.

Priya Singh: DONE — renewal asks drafted.

Ava Morales: Excellent — I’ll consolidate and run the rehearsal notes. Putting a quick follow-up: please be in the rehearsal room 5 minutes early. :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: Thanks, team. Will pull the final PDF and send to execs post-rehearsal.

Ava Morales: Closing out thread — leaving meeting invite now. If anything urgent, ping me DM. :rocket:
